question: For two-factor authentication, does CISA consider codes from an authenticator app more secure than codes sent by SMS text message?
true_option: Yes — app-based codes are more secure; SMS is vulnerable to SIM-swapping and interception
false_option: No — SMS codes are just as secure as authenticator app codes
true_claim_text: authenticator apps are more secure than SMS codes, which are exposed to SIM swapping
false_claim_text: SMS codes are just as secure as authenticator app codes
source: CISA multifactor authentication guidance: SMS-based MFA is the weakest common form because texts can be intercepted or captured via SIM swapping; authenticator apps and phishing-resistant methods are stronger.
